LJCDataColumns.summary: Represents a collection of DbColumn objects.
LJCDataColumns.remarks: A DbColumn collection element can also be retrieved by name using the collection object: columns["ColumnName"];

LJCMinSqlDate.returns: The minimum value in database format.

LJCObjectDataColumns.summary: Creates LJCDataColumns from a Data Object.

LJCObjectPropertyNames.summary: Creates a PropertyNames list from a DataObject.

LJCDataValues.summary: Creates a DbValues object from a DbColumns object. (E)

LJCChanged.summary: Gets a collection of changed columns.

LJCClearChanged.summary: Sets the IsChanged value to false for all elements in the collection.

LJCColumns.summary: Returns a collection of columns that match the supplied list.

LJCKeyPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from the unique keys.

LJCPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from the collection items.

Add1.summary: Adds the object element to the collection

Add2.summary: Creates the Object from the arguments and adds it to the collection.
Add2.remarks: This method is useful for data sources that require a column position value. An example would be a text file that uses fixed length fields.

Add3.summary: Creates the Object from the arguments and adds it to the collection.

LJCGetUnique.summary: Gets the column that matches the key columns.

LJCRemove.summary: Removes the item with the supplied property name.

LJCSort.summary: Sorts on the current key columns.

LJCSetCaptions.summary: Sets caption properties for supplied columns from current columns.

LJCMapNames.summary: Maps the column property and rename values.

LJCBoolean.summary: Gets the column object value as a bool.

LJCByte.summary: Gets the column object value as a byte.

LJCChar.summary: Gets the column object value as a char.

LJCDbDateTime.summary: Gets the column object value as a DateTime.

LJCDecimal.summary: Gets the column object value as a decimal value.

LJCDouble.summary: Gets the column object value as a double.

LJCInt16.summary: Gets the column object value as a short int.

LJCInt32.summary: Gets the column object value as an int.

LJCInt64.summary: Gets the column object value as a long int.

LJCSingle.summary: Gets the column object value as a single.

LJCValue.summary: Gets the column object value as an object.

LJCSetValue.summary: Sets the value for the column with the specified name.

Item.summary: The column for the specified property name.
